Ayers was hired as the fourth Sam Houston women's soccer coach in program history in the spring of 2025. She had previously served as the head coach at Texas Southern.\u003Cbr />\r\n  \u003Cbr />\r\nIn her first and only season with the Tigers in 2024, Ayers guided Texas Southern to the program's first Southwestern Athletic Conference regular season championship and the championship game of the league's postseason tournament. She was named the SWAC Coach of the Year and developed the league's Offensive and Defensive Players of the Year.\u003Cbr />\r\n \u003Cbr />\r\nThe Tigers went 9-9-2 overall and 6-1-1 in conference play. Texas Southern beat Prairie View and Alabama A&M to reach the finals of the SWAC Tournament where it fell to Southern 1-0 in the title game.\u003Cbr />\r\n \u003Cbr />\r\nPrior to Texas Southern, spent two seasons as the head coach at Louisiana Christian University, where she led the squad to an 18-10-4 record. The all-time leader in wins in school history, Ayers took the Wildcats to postseason play in both seasons and had three student-athletes receive All-Red River Athletic Conference accolades.\u003Cbr />\r\n \u003Cbr />\r\nAyers also spent two seasons (2021-22) as an assistant at Navarro College in Corsicana. The Bastrop native began her playing career at Cisco College helping the Lady Wranglers become Region 5 conference champions and district finalists in 2013. Predominantly a defensive player, while at Cisco she scored 12 goals, including three game-winners, and had 15 assists on the way to being named to the 2013 NSCAA Junior College Division I All-West Region Team.\u003Cbr />\r\n \u003Cbr />\r\nAyers is no stranger to Conference USA, having closed her playing career with two seasons at Louisiana Tech. After graduation in 2017, Ayers spent two years playing professionally in Greece where she also served as the sports psychologist for the AO Trikala professional men's soccer team and head goalkeeper 2017.\u003C/p>\r\n\r\n\u003Cp>LeNorman, who received his Bachelor of Science in Health from Sam Houston in 2007, is a current adjunct faculty member with the department of kinesiology as well as staff
